page.overview:
Who is Abigail Wright?

When Bruce Banner, with the mind of the Hulk, was put into a straitjacket and a padded room, Mercy visited him, invisible to everyone but him. When she asked Bruce what was wrong, he told her that he wanted Betty. Misunderstanding him, Mercy told Bruce that she would handle Betty and teleported away. Elsewhere the spirit of Betty Banner ran into Mercy and, in her infantile state, Betty talked about missing her mother. Mercy asked Betty if she would like to visit her mom and find out what to do next, to which the spirit of Betty agreed. As the two teleported away, Betty's body flatlined, prompting the surgeons to scramble to revive her. After Bruce managed to transform into the Hulk again, Mercy appeared before him once more, not happy that he convinced her to stay, pointing out that she must love him more than she loved herself. Hulk said he felt the same way about Betty, but Mercy put doubt into that before disappearing once again.

Later, Hulk hid on a plane to New York, but the passengers found out and quietly started to panic. In the middle of this, Dr. Calvin Zabo transformed into Mister Hyde and explained to the Hulk that he was also hired to fight the Hulk. However, Mercy appeared, and revealed that she had suppressed the Hulk's conscious mind so that Mister Hyde could more easily kill him, as the Hulk was currently suicidal. Mister Hyde was then giving Mercy a lecture about end-of-life decisions, partly motivated by the fact that he defined himself in opposition to the Hulk, and if the Hulk was diminished then he felt it reflected poorly on him. Hulk managed to fight through Mercy's telepathy and crudely attempted to fight off Mister Hyde. As Hyde strangled Hulk, Hulk choked out a confession – he wanted to die, but not at the hands of Mister Hyde, who he did not respect. Mercy, acknowledging this, lifted her telepathy. Hulk, now clear-headed, easily threw Mister Hyde through a nearby wall.

In New York, Abigail assisted Abomination in fighting Hulk. However, as Abomination was knocked unconscious, Mercy realized that her efforts would not result in her desired aim. Hulk wanted to know why she had suddenly taken an interest in him, and she admitted that it was purely professional pride. He represented her unfinished business, and she wanted to kill him before it became pointless. But if she could not, it didn't matter, and she must be leaving as the Celestials are coming back to Earth.
